note: Private RV park on a cove of Kentucky Lake beside an RV sales and service lot. Only sites 16 and 17, at the south-east corner of the loop, open onto the water over mown grass; the 'waterfront' row 21-27 sits behind a wooded strip. summary: Little Eagle RV confirmed: $45-105 (Deluxe 30 $45 base, under the $50 gate), 66 sites (52 FHU + 14 W/E), max 55 ft, pull-throughs; ~29 sites offered nightly on December 2026 dates (2027 not open); Google 4.5 (164). Lakefront kept on sites 16/17 (~30-40 m open grass to the cove/dock, pads ~3 m above summer pool); 21-27 are behind trees. Pin on the sales lot ~170 m N of the loop (under 250 m).
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept with a caveat, on two sites only. Sites 16 (Waterfront Back In, $75) and 17 (Waterfront Back In Premium Patio, $85), at the loop's SE corner ~36.4305,-88.1061, sit ~30-40 m over open mown grass from the cove shore and a dock; pads ~112.5 m vs Kentucky Lake summer pool 109.4 m on a gentle grass slope (110.4 m at 15 m). Both sold by the night on Campspot. The operator's other 'Waterfront' sites 21-27 (east row, ~36.4312,-88.1058) are ~35-45 m from the water through a continuous wooded strip - not open ground. Previous evidence ('open apron at the waterline on S/E edge') matches only the SE corner.

PRICE: cheapest real RV night $45 base (Deluxe 30 Backin, 30-ft max) - under the $50 gate; it showed no free site on the December dates read, and the next tier is $55 (Deluxe 40, fits 23 ft). If the Deluxe 30 sites are not truly bookable, the cheapest is $55 (over the gate); gateways.py not run since the posted $45 type exists.

LONG-STAY: 29 of the 53 mapped pads (operator says 66 RV sites) were offered nightly on both a Tuesday and a Saturday in December 2026; the 2022 site advertised annual leases, the current site does not. Not mostly seasonal on this evidence; summer share unreadable (2027 not open). Google 4.5 with 164 reviews.
PIN: stored 36.43234,-88.10803 is on the RV sales lot by the camp store; the campground loop centre is ~36.4311,-88.1069 (~170 m SSE). Under 250 m, optional move.
RULES: renters 21+; RVs '15 years old or newer' (older by approval) - a 2023 rig passes.

WEBSITE: https://www.littleeaglervpark.com/ is live but reads as a generic rewrite (no rates); the Campspot listing is the bookable presence. Phone 731-642-4669 confirmed (Campspot cancellation policy).
DISCOUNTS: stored military true not re-checked (no discount wording on the pages read).
